quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to park a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter upon a street other than upon the roadway against the curb or upon the sidewalk in a rack to support the bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter or against a building or at the curb, in such a manner as to afford the least obstruction to pedestrian traffic.

activation.condition: A bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter is parked upon a street.

obligation.description: Park on the roadway against the curb or on the sidewalk in a supporting rack, against a building, or at the curb, with the least obstruction to pedestrian traffic.

timing.description: While the device remains parked; no statutory numeric duration is stated.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Pedestrian obstruction requires reviewed geometry, pedestrian corridor and parked-device footprint; the law supplies no numerical cutoff.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-reviewed rack, sidewalk, curb and pedestrian corridor geometry
